build_H3DWModel: build an H3DWModel instance with an opt config to initialize the SMPLX hand mesh encoder
run_extract_hand_output: run extract_hand_output to extract hand vertices and joints from an SMPLX output for left or right hand
run_forward_H3DWModel: run the H3DWModel forward pass to predict camera, pose, and shape parameters from input images
test_H3DWModel: test the H3DWModel by calling test to perform a no-grad forward pass and get predictions
run_get_pred_result: run get_pred_result on H3DWModel to retrieve predicted camera, pose, shape, vertices, and 3D joints as numpy arrays
